recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if a future publisher/template regression removes Raw JSON links from generated *.profile.json.html pages; the fix would belong in the active publisher/template path rather than in retired DAF profile source.

additional_context: The original DAF example URL from Jira is no longer present in current core source or source/fhir.ini, and active current resource/profile JSON pages are generated through the current build/publisher pipeline. Current build output for representative resource and profile StructureDefinition JSON pages includes Raw JSON links, while community and Jira searches found no later conflicting decision for FHIR-6338.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current built specification already exposes Raw JSON links on the relevant generated JSON profile pages, and there is no active core DAF profile source left to correct.
